_why: One row per finding in the headless-readiness audit, with what was done
and the check that proves it. Written as data so scripts/aud_ledger.py can
RUN the proof rather than restate it: a disposition with no runnable check
is a claim, and this whole exercise is about the difference.
FIXED         repaired in this repository, with a test that fails without
DESIGNED_OUT  the defect belonged to the supplied v4.2 research archive,
which is not in this repository. The audit's own repair
direction (AUD-0002) forbids patching it where it sits, so
the engine was rebuilt in the plugin on the workbook
substrate with the defect made structurally impossible, and
a test holds it that way.
MITIGATED     the defect is in a pinned Google Drive document this
session cannot edit. What is in reach was built: a
machine-readable contract, the scripts the document
mandates, or a checker that reports the divergence.
OPEN          not addressed. Stated, not hidden.

findings.title: The client folder is created at the END, so a run that stops early leaves nothing an operator can find
findings.target: engine/assemble.py:package (refuses until all four deliverables exist); Golden 1 run R-GOLDEN1-P1C1 finished a category and created no folder
findings.note: engine.assemble open_folder creates '<Entity> - DMA' at `start` with run_manifest.json at status IN_PROGRESS, records it in Run_Metadata.client_folder, and pushes it to intake; `package` COMPLETES that folder rather than creating one. A run without one is the watchdog state NO_CLIENT_FOLDER.

findings.title: The binding rests on free text nobody checked: no financial statement was read, no revenue line examined, and AskUserQuestion was never used
findings.target: engine/runstate.py:vet_basis (refuses FILLER, accepts any fluent sentence); cli start --sv-basis/--mode-basis
findings.note: engine/preflight.py: the basis is a preflight-v1 DOCUMENT carrying the financial-statement review (revenue lines, each naming the LOB it implies), the LOB census (ACCEPT/REJECT per sub-vertical, every material LOB examined) and the AskUserQuestion exchange with the owner's verbatim answer. The binding must MATCH the answer; two material LOBs make the question mandatory. sv_basis/mode_basis/lob_census are RENDERED from the file, so they cannot drift from it.

findings.title: No preliminary research: the run profiles the capabilities and never the institution, so the Client Research Profile has nothing to render from
findings.target: Golden 1: Entity_Timeline, Tech_Register and Peer_Benchmarks all empty at run end; no phase was ever asked to fill them
findings.note: engine/prelim.py: six sections (financials, firmographics, leadership, timeline, peers, tech_baseline), each closed by RESEARCH or by a DECLARED absence with its ladder. `orient` serves no category card while any is open, and every narrative section must cite registered evidence.

findings.title: The workbook validates while six of nineteen tabs are empty — the validator checks shape, and nothing checked content
findings.target: engine/validator.py rules 1-2 pass a sheet with correct headers and no rows; REF_Method was a declared sheet with no writer at all
findings.note: engine/completeness.py: every tab is populated or carries a recorded reason in Run_Metadata.empty_sheet_reasons; nine sheets may never be declared empty. Blocks handoff and package. REF_Method now has a writer, rendered from the contract.

findings.title: Agents stop mid-run with no self-healing: the watchdog cannot see a new DMA and cannot restart one
findings.target: engine/watchdog.py:sweep listed $DMA_RUN_ROOT, which does not survive the container, and every state was a report
findings.note: engine/registry.py: append-only run registry written at every start and round-tripped through Drive, so a fresh container sees the population. watchdog.sweep reads it (MISSING_LOCALLY carries the recovery command); every row carries a resume plan naming the agent and prompt; --revive dispatches through agent_run.py. HALTED and UNREADABLE are never revived automatically.

findings.title: ERS is a contract column with a full calculator and nothing joining them — empty in every run ever produced
findings.target: engine/ledger.py:append_evidence took ers as an optional caller argument defaulting to None; no caller passed one; scripts/calculate_ers.py ran over an evidence_index.json projection no stage feeds. Golden 1: 20 rows, 20 empty cells
findings.note: engine/ers.py computes it at the write and RECOMPUTES across the register (corroboration is a property of the register). Specificity reads the RRF consensus and BM25 fit where 02_search carries them and SAYS SO when it falls back; corroboration counts source IDENTITIES, not rows, matching single_source_fact.

findings.title: All sixteen report sections have no owner: the renderer refuses a missing section and nothing writes one
findings.target: engine/report_spec.py declares 8+8 sections; Report_Narrative was written only by prelim/preflight PRELIM-* rows. Measured by scripts/audit_coverage.py
findings.note: engine/narrative.py makes a section a RECORD (Weighing, Absence_Basis, Assumptions, Bias_Notes, Inference_Tags, computed Accuracy_Basis) with an independent Review_Verdict; report-research-producer, report-assessment-producer and report-validator generated from the spec by gen_report_agents.py --check so a new section fails the build until it has an owner. The renderer now refuses an unreviewed section.

findings.title: The technographic scan is a side effect of category researchers with no owning agent
findings.target: techscan.record called opportunistically by 16 researchers; no agent works the four layers deliberately, so layers_never_looked_at could not be honest
findings.note: agents/research/technographic-scanner.md owns it: four layers worked deliberately, status earned by evidence kind, connector gaps emitted as search_requests rather than fabricated. Its JSON is asserted against the app's own parse_technographic_scan.

findings.title: Nothing in the engine knew what a run cost; the $5/pillar ceiling was a hope
findings.target: Golden 1 measured: $6.45 for six subcaps, 76% of it cache reads (130K re-read on each of 188 turns). A 690-cell engagement projects to ~$741 against a $20 target
findings.note: engine/cost.py prices a run from the rate card and states four levers with their arithmetic: capability grain (x0.20), turn discipline (x0.26), context hygiene (x0.50), model tiering (x0.65, a PLACEHOLDER and labelled as one) -> $12.46 against $20. MITIGATED not DESIGNED_OUT: three levers are arithmetic, the fourth is unmeasured, and none is enforced by the harness yet.

findings.title: No routine starts a DMA assessment: five Routines watch, rectify, refresh and promote, and none begins a run
findings.target: list_triggers 2026-08-30: dma-watchdog, sequence-a, sequence-b, refresh-drift-daily, rectification-weekly
findings.note: dma-assessment-intake (trig_018eeMRDobRQXPZ4aobjfUih, 59 * * * *) prepares the binding for unstarted client folders and STOPS at the AskUserQuestion, which a headless firing cannot answer. Half-hourly was specified and the API enforces an hourly minimum; the canon records the built cadence, not the wished-for one.

findings.title: Template adherence was unverifiable: the template's identifier appeared nowhere in the plugin
findings.target: the read-only-template rule is real, and nothing compared the built shape against the maintained one
findings.note: engine/template.py diffs a local copy against contract.SHEETS — shape only, since the template's rows are placeholders by design. The CONTRACT is authoritative; the check exists to make divergence visible while somebody can still decide which side is wrong.
